author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video for a look at some of the stunning cross-platform mobile games that have been created recently in Unreal Engine.

Built by talented studios from all different parts of the world, these games are a showcase of what’s possible when teams combine great ideas with Unreal Engine’s powerful toolset.

The studios featured have achieved these results using the same mobile features that are battle-tested by Epic in Fortnite, including high-fidelity rendering; tools to efficiently optimize performance and memory; advanced systems for networking and multiplayer gameplay; and many others. 

Find out more about creating mobile games in Unreal Engine here: https://unrealengine.com/uses/mobile-games

title: Cross-Platform Mobile Games Sizzle Reel | Unreal Engine
